svg.text: Two motors. One complete connection map.
USB-C PD power · parallel motor supply · one shared RS485 daisy-chain
A/B daisy-chain · use a twisted pair
Optional reference lead from J2 pin 1
Motor power: J1. Data: J2 pin 2 = A, pin 3 = B. Both motor power returns and controller GND share one reference.
20 V is nominal after PD negotiation. Verify J1 voltage and polarity before attaching motors.
Drawing is schematic; not to scale. Motor pigtail strip shows functions, not a connector mating-face view.
